title: Tarpit ideas, the sequel: why seductive startup ideas keep failing and how new tech reopens them
summary: Dalton Caldwell and Michael Seibel clarify that a tarpit idea is not just a bad idea. It is one many founders keep independently having, that earns lots of praise, and that keeps failing. The list is not static: new technology like LLMs can reopen old ideas, so founders should explain what changed and talk to users.

principles.text: A tarpit is a small subset of ideas that attract many founders and keep failing, not simply ideas you dislike.
principles.quote: tarpet ideas are a smallish set of ideas yes there's lots of ideas that are neither good nor bad they're just normal

principles.text: Too much positive feedback and a feeling that 'why does this not already exist' are warning signs, not validation.
principles.quote: if you're getting too much positive feedback if it feels like why does this already exist it seems so easy that's not like the shape of things that we see working

principles.text: The tarpit list is not static. New technology can make a previously failed idea workable, so explain what changed.
principles.quote: What I love to see is when a Founder can explain to me why the new technology might make something accomplishable that wasn't accomplishable before

principles.text: Ignoring that many people already tried and failed is a red flag. Do the research on prior attempts.
principles.quote: What I hate to see is a Founder that's not even acknowledging that like many people have tried and failed before

principles.text: Each new technology wave opens a new set of solvable problems, so re-explore what is now possible.
principles.quote: whatever current set of technology is available can address only a current set of problems and like some problems are going to fall outside of that set and every time there's a new chunk of Technology we have to re-explore

principles.text: To check whether your idea is a tarpit, talk to users and get a customer first.
principles.quote: when some of the people ask me oh is my idea tarpit I'll be like hey well have you talked to any users
